name: Farm & Wilderness Summer Camps
description_short: A group of summer camps in Plymouth, Vermont, for ages 4 to 17: 3-week overnight camps (Firefly Song, Timberlake, Saltash Mountain, Tamarack Farm), a 2-week overnight camp (The Clearing), a 1-week overnight session (Spark), and Barn Day Camp for ages 4-10. Tuition is on a sliding scale by family income.
refund_policy_summary: Full payment is due June 1. Deposits are $500 per child per session for overnight camp and $100 for day camp. Deposits are non-refundable except for some campership (financial aid) applicants. If you cancel before March 1, the deposit is kept or rolled over, and tuition paid beyond the deposit can be refunded, rolled over, transferred to a sibling, or donated. Between March 1 and June 1, there is no refund, but tuition paid can be rolled over, transferred, or donated. After June 1, all payments are kept. There are no refunds for arriving late, leaving early, being dismissed, or withdrawing voluntarily. Optional third-party trip insurance is available.
special_needs_notes: After registration, staff pre-screen each camper's medical and behavioral health information to make sure the camper can meet the essential functions of camp. Families are asked to share this information openly.
